stageHelp.intake: A report, sandbox verdict, incident or intelligence item arrived.
stageHelp.analysis: An analyst checks what it is and how dangerous it is.
stageHelp.conversion: The finding becomes a lesson or support material.
stageHelp.approval: A person approves the material before anyone sees it.
stageHelp.targeting: The people who need it are chosen.
stageHelp.feedback: Results are measured and the loop is closed.

ops.subtitle: Everything that needs a security decision today, in one place.
ops.timeToClose: Median time to close a loop
ops.liveEmpty: No live or high-severity incidents. Good.

loops.subtitle: Each real threat followed from the first report to the training it produced.
loops.closeBody: Closing records the result. The loop moves to feedback and leaves the open list.

threats.subtitle: Everything employees reported, ready for triage.
threats.simulationHint: Matched to a phishing simulation: the employee did the right thing.
threats.convertBody: Starts a closed loop from this report so it ends in training.
threats.dismissBody: Not a threat. The report stays in the history.

errors.already: This report has already been turned into a loop.
errors.plan: Closed loops are not included in your plan.

approvals.subtitle: No AI or template material reaches employees before a person approves it.
approvals.title: Title
approvals.empty: Nothing waiting. Every material has a decision.
approvals.sameApprover: The second approval must come from a different person.
approvals.approved: Approved. {count, plural, one {# person gets} other {# people get}} the lesson.
approvals.firstApproved: First approval recorded. A second approver is needed.

incidents.subtitle: Real incidents and the training that follows them.
incidents.confidentialHint: Employees see only the number, never the details. Webhooks get no details.
incidents.liveHint: Shown at the top of the operations center until resolved.
incidents.title: Title
incidents.iocsHint: Domains, URLs, IP addresses, hashes or file names. Shown defanged (example[.]com) so nobody opens them by accident.
incidents.mitreHint: For example, T1566.002; separate several with commas
incidents.assigned: Training assigned to {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}

sandbox.subtitle: Static analysis of files and links. Nothing is opened or run.

risk.subtitle: Human risk per person, with the evidence behind every score.
risk.explain: Lower is better. The score adds unfinished training, overdue work, risky simulation actions, open risks and first-try answer accuracy.

intel.threatSubtitle: Current attacks from public sources, turned into training before they reach you.
intel.policySubtitle: New rules and standards that change what your people must learn or sign.
intel.convertThreatBody: Opens a closed loop and drafts a support material for the approval gate.
intel.convertPolicyBody: Creates a policy draft you can complete and publish for sign-off.
intel.convertedThreat: Loop opened and material sent for approval

leadership.subtitle: The security picture for management, in plain numbers.
leadership.change: {sign}{abs, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} in 30 days
leadership.topRisksEmpty: No high or critical open risks.

headline.good: Risk is going down and people report more than they click.
headline.watch: Risk is stable. Focus on overdue training and repeat clickers.
headline.bad: Risk is rising. Review open incidents and overdue training this week.

studio.subtitle: Create your own short lessons and support materials.
studio.deleteBody: The lesson is removed permanently, together with its assignments. Only a lesson nobody has started can be deleted: once someone has progress, a confirmation or a certificate for it, someone has an open risk this lesson closes, or an incident trains with it, use “Move to drafts” instead, which keeps their results and certificate links.
studio.deleteInUse: This lesson was not deleted: people already have progress, confirmations or certificates for it, someone has an open risk this lesson closes, or an incident trains with it. Use “Move to drafts” instead.

form.title: Title
form.subtitle: One-line summary
form.pointsHint: AI Sel reads each point aloud as a step of the lesson.
form.question: Check question
form.aiTopicPlaceholder: For example: the fake courier SMS our staff received this week
form.aiDone: Draft ready. Read and correct it before saving.
form.aiOffline: AI is not connected. Fill in the fields yourself.
form.aiFailed: The draft could not be written. Try again or write it yourself.
form.swipeHint: The learner sorts messages into safe and trap. Fill in 2 to 4 messages, at least one of them a trap; empty rows are skipped.
form.hotspotHint: The learner finds the warning signs in an e-mail. Copy the text of each sign exactly as it is written in the e-mail; empty rows are skipped.
form.signText: Text of the sign, as in the e-mail
form.targetMissing: This text is not found on one line of the e-mail, or it overlaps another sign. Copy it exactly as it is written there.

studio.sourceOnly: AI translation is not connected: the lesson stays in the language it was written in, and employees who use other languages see it in that language.
studio.untranslated: The lesson could not be translated into {languages}. Employees who use these languages see the original text.

paths.subtitle: Ordered sets of lessons for roles and regulations.
paths.deleteBody: Assignments of this path are removed too. A path with issued certificates cannot be deleted: the certificates and their public links are compliance evidence.
paths.deleteInUse: This path was not deleted: certificates have already been issued for it.

form.title: Title
form.labsHint: Shown after the modules. Each lab opens for a learner once the lessons it practises are done.

sessions.subtitle: Live demonstrations, briefings and Q&A sessions.

form.title: Title
form.durationRange: The duration must be between 5 and 480 minutes.
form.capacityRange: Enter at least 1 seat (at most 100,000), or leave it empty for no limit.

sessions.deleteBody: Registered people are notified that the session is cancelled.

feedback.subtitle: What employees think of the lessons and the platform.

aiTrainer.title: Create a training with AI
aiTrainer.subtitle: Describe what people should learn. AI writes the lessons, checks them automatically, and you review the draft before anyone sees it.
aiTrainer.offlineBody: An administrator has to set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server. Until then you can build a draft from the closest library lesson: it goes through the same format and safety checks, without the AI review.
aiTrainer.promptHint: Topic, audience and tone, in a sentence or two.
aiTrainer.promptPlaceholder: For example: teach warehouse staff to recognise fake delivery text messages. Calm, friendly tone, everyday examples.
aiTrainer.generating: AI is writing the training and checking it. This can take a minute or two…
aiTrainer.building: Building a draft from the library and checking it…

howHelp.write: Topic, audience, tone, language and length.
howHelp.check: Lesson format, links, contacts, wording and answers.
howHelp.review: A second AI pass checks facts and clarity. Problems are fixed once automatically.
howHelp.publish: The training is saved as a draft. Open it in the player, then publish it from the list.

errors.invalid: Describe the topic in at least one sentence.
errors.offline: AI is not connected. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or build from the library.
errors.failed: The training could not be prepared. Try again or reword the prompt.
errors.noMatch: No library lesson matches this prompt. Try other keywords or another category.

stepHelp.schema: Lesson structure, scene types and the links between steps.
stepHelp.safety: Only example domains, no real emails or phone numbers, no offensive words, correct answers, known illustrations.
stepHelp.review: Facts, clarity for non-technical staff, and whether it teaches what you asked.

notes.blocked: Skipped until the earlier checks pass.
notes.unavailable: The reviewer did not answer. Review the content yourself.

verdictHelp.verified: All three checks passed. Read it once in the player, then publish it.
verdictHelp.needs_review: Some checks failed or were skipped. Go through the points below before you publish.

aiTrainer.regenerated: The first version had problems, so it was written again once with them as feedback.
aiTrainer.contentLanguage: The lesson text of this library module is in {language}.

issues.wrongType: This field has the wrong kind of value.
issues.textShort: The text is too short: at least {min, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
issues.textLong: The text is too long: at most {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
issues.numberSmall: The number is too small: at least {min}.
issues.numberLarge: The number is too large: at most {max}.
issues.badValue: This value is not supported here.
issues.badFormat: This part does not follow the lesson format.
issues.duplicateSceneId: Two scenes have the same id “{id}”.
issues.startMissing: The scenario starts at step “{node}”, which does not exist.
issues.nextMissing: A choice leads to step “{next}”, which does not exist.
issues.noCorrectOption: The question has no correct answer.
issues.minToFindTooHigh: The scene asks learners to find more signs than it has.
issues.structure: The lesson structure has a problem.
issues.emailOutside: Email address outside the example domains: {value}
issues.optionIdsRepeat: Two answers have the same id.
issues.multiFewCorrect: A question with several right answers needs at least 2 correct ones; this one has {count}.
issues.multiNoWrong: A question with several right answers has no wrong answer.
issues.singleCorrectCount: A question with one right answer needs exactly 1 correct answer; this one has {count}.
issues.spotNotMarked: The sign “{spot}” is not marked in the sample material.
issues.orderIdsRepeat: Two items to put in order have the same id.
issues.swipeNoThreat: The “Safe or threat” cards include no threat.

aiTrainer.saved: Saved as a draft. Nobody sees it until you publish it from the list.
aiTrainer.draftNotice: Saving creates a draft. Employees do not see it until you publish it.
